businesses.business: regenerative wound care and surgical products

offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures products for treating chronic and acute wounds and supporting surgical tissue repair. It supplies hospitals, wound care centers, and physician practices with cellular skin substitutes, tissue grafts, and wound matrices.

primary_products.value: living skin substitutes; placental tissue grafts; collagen wound matrices; surgical soft tissue grafts

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, outpatient wound care centers, podiatry practices, and surgical practices

end_markets.value: advanced wound care; reconstructive surgery; orthopedic surgery and sports medicine

revenue_model.value: product sales: wound care and surgical grafts and matrices purchased by healthcare providers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: uses donated tissue, cultured cells, and collagen to make products for hospitals and clinics

geography_served.value: US national: hospitals and clinics across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: advanced wound care products and grafts for surgical tissue repair

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: company sales representatives serving hospitals, wound centers, and physician practices; agents / brokers: independent sales agencies serving healthcare providers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA approvals or clearances for certain products and federal human tissue rules for applicable grafts
